content:
TEMPTATION ||| Lean closer, letting the tension fill the space between us ||| "What if I just refuse to answer your question?"  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, creating distance from his probing gaze ||| "I won't let you turn this into a spectacle."  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his eyes, vulnerability shining through ||| "I need you to trust me, even when I hesitate."  
REVERSAL ||| Hold the blade firmly, claiming my stance in this ritual ||| "I will dictate the terms of this moment, not you."  
SILENCE ||| My breath catches in my throat, the weight of the moment pressing down |||
